The risk assessment tool allows users to view the potential population outcomes (Density Distributions) and risks of a range of percentages of population decline (Risk Estimates) under different climate and land-use scenarios, relative to a baseline scenario of no oil sands development and historic climate, for the selected species. 

### Area of interest (AOI) and lease selection

- **Step 1.** Select the species of interest from the dropdown list. 

- **Step 2.** Select the area of interest from the dropdown list.. It can be the entire OSR (Full OSR), the portion of the OSR covered by all leases (All Leases), or a specific lease (by name) 

- **Step 3.** Click on Show Selected Species and Area. 

- **Step 3.** Toggle between the distributions and risk estimates, and download the risk data and plots using the button on the right pane.
